page.layout: Running head at top centre; page number at top right. Two parallel columns of single-line entries, left column then right column. Signature at the foot right. No margin notes.
page.notes: Running head "DIVERSIS." and page number 61 are printed at the top. Signature "H 5" is printed at the foot right. "Foloni" in the right column: the initial letter may be P in this face; marked [?]. "Ruffani": the double f is probably a ligature for a double s; kept as printed. "Dalmatę" (both entries) and "Epirotæ": the final letter is a ligature-like form (ę/æ); transcribed as printed as best as possible. "Slesii" and "Slesitæ" in the right column: the long s is read as printed. Ligature forms of "Plefcovii" and "Sorebi" are taken as printed; the hyphenated line breaks ("Plefco-vienses", "Mazobi-tæ", "Mofcovi-tæ", "Obotri-ti", "po-tius") keep the printed hyphen.
